tokens.note: Abbreviation of המוציא לאור (the one who brings out to the light), written with gershayim before the final letter. It is the heading of the publisher's voice, not the author's.

grammar: המו"ל is a one-word heading with no verb and no syntax; it names the speaker of the paragraph that follows.
The abbreviation stands for המוציא לאור, and the English gives the ordinary title 'the publisher'.
The publisher's voice (1:10 to 1:13) is not the author's, as the decisions for this work require.
segments.note: Heading only; the section it introduces is translated in its own unit.
